findings.quote: Same as `Self::open_or_refresh_config_pane`: an overlay open when this reply landed must not survive the body change under it.
findings.what: The code handling a `Sent::SheepConfig` reply sets `self.body = Body::ConfigPane(pane)` but never resets `self.keymap_open`, so an overlay that was open before the reply will remain open after the body changes, causing key events to be sent to the overlay instead of the new pane.
